Generated Narrative: ValueSet R5-questionnaire-disabled-display-for-R4

This value set expansion contains 2 concepts.

SystemVersionCodeDisplayDefinition
http://hl7.org/fhir/questionnaire-disabled-display5.0.0  hiddenHidden

The item (and its children) should not be visible to the user at all.

http://hl7.org/fhir/questionnaire-disabled-display5.0.0  protectedProtected

The item (and possibly its children) should not be selectable or editable but should still be visible - to allow the user to see what questions could have been completed had other answers caused the item to be enabled.
